body.cta_section_title: Want similar SEO results in the UAE?
body.cta_section_text: Read the full Moduluxe case study for project details, metrics and the technology stack behind the results.

content_blocks.content:
Moduluxe Group operates in the UAE rental market from Abu Dhabi. Their previous web presence did not reflect the brand quality they delivered offline, and organic visibility in English and Arabic searches was limited.

The goal was clear: generate quality leads from organic search, improve trust on first visit and build a foundation for long-term SEO growth without sacrificing performance on mobile.

content_blocks.text: Strategy: bilingual SEO on a modern stack

content_blocks.content:
IGENXT rebuilt the site on Next.js with Tailwind CSS and Storyblok CMS for flexible content management. The architecture prioritised Core Web Vitals, clean URL structure and bilingual pages with proper SEO signals.

Technical work included schema markup, optimised metadata, image performance and crawl-friendly sitemaps. Content structure supported both English and Arabic discovery, aligned with our bilingual development guide.

image.alt: Moduluxe Group bilingual website built by IGENTX

content_blocks.caption: Performance-first bilingual architecture supported SEO gains for Moduluxe Group.

content_blocks.content:
Within three months of launch, Moduluxe achieved 300% organic traffic growth. Performance scores reached 95+ through Next.js optimisation and caching. The site ranked more effectively in both Arabic and English searches, feeding a steady pipeline of enquiries.

These metrics come from the published Moduluxe Group case study. Results vary by industry and starting point, but the pattern holds: technical SEO plus bilingual content on a fast site drives measurable visibility.

content_blocks.text: The new website transformed our online presence. We started getting quality leads from day one, and the bilingual SEO setup helped us rank in both Arabic and English searches.
content_blocks.author: Murshid CK

content_blocks.text: What other UAE businesses can learn

content_blocks.content:
Three lessons apply beyond real estate:

  • Performance is SEO: Fast pages improve engagement signals and rankings.
  • Bilingual equals broader reach: UAE markets search in two languages; serve both properly.
  • CMS flexibility supports SEO: Marketing teams need to publish and optimise without developer delays.

Pair this case with our local SEO guide and technical SEO checklist to audit your own site.

body.faq_description: Questions about the Moduluxe Group SEO case study.

faqs.question: How was 300% traffic growth measured?
faqs.answer: Organic traffic was tracked before and after launch over a three-month window, as documented in the Moduluxe Group case study. Baselines and analytics setup were part of the engagement.

faqs.question: What technology stack did Moduluxe use?
faqs.answer: Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Storyblok CMS on a performance-optimised hosting setup. The stack supports bilingual content, fast loads and flexible marketing updates.

faqs.question: Can similar results be guaranteed for my business?
faqs.answer: No agency can guarantee specific rankings or traffic multiples. Moduluxe results reflect their market, content investment and technical starting point. We scope realistic KPIs during discovery.

faqs.question: Does IGENTX provide ongoing SEO after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer technical SEO, content support and reporting for UAE clients who want compounding organic growth after the initial build.
